MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The battery organizer fits my practical maintenance purchases: I use remotes and peripherals, and I have bought a battery tester, so organizing and checking batteries feels useful.",
    "The over-ear headphones offer a useful listening option at my computer, and multipoint connection appeals to me because I use several devices."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Both Fire TV sticks duplicate the purpose of my recent 4K Max bundle, while the older Echo Dot offers no clear benefit alongside my fourth-generation Dot and Echo Show.",
    "The earbuds do not meet a current need for me; owning a gaming bundle does not mean I want gaming audio or decorative lighting.",
    "The router and internal SSD relate to things I have bought, but I would need a networking problem or a compatible computer upgrade planned before choosing them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Alexa purchases seem to be treated as a reason to buy more Alexa devices, even when those devices repeat functions I already have.",
    "My computer accessories and gaming bundle seem to imply a broad interest in any connected gadget, although I choose accessories for specific practical uses."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter: an accessory that supports something I own can be useful, while another device serving the same purpose often is not.",
    "My history of replacement batteries, adapters, and protection plans suggests that keeping existing equipment useful matters to me.",
    "I distinguish between an immediately useful accessory and an upgrade that requires a specific problem, compatibility check, or replacement plan."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in home and computer equipment but miss the practical needs and recent purchases that determine what I would choose next."
}
